mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased supply-side activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 30% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month and the capacity utilization rate (implied by INDPRO) falls below 78%, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 0.5% MoM and implied capacity utilization < 78%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% MoM and implied capacity utilization is below 78%.
